1 /**
2  * Anchor prefs → subscription seat resolution (W5).
3  * Families map to subscription CLIs only (chatgpt-cli / claude / gemini-cli|agy / grok-cli).
4  * Never hardcodes product model IDs; never uses XAI_API_KEY HTTP for production seats.
5  * Prefs load order: injected fixture → settings/model_prefs paths via env/home.
6  * Family-valued environment variables are compatibility outputs, never inputs.
7  * No host-absolute path string literals (home from USERPROFILE/HOME only).
8  */
9 
10 import fs from 'node:fs';
11 import path from 'node:path';
12 import os from 'node:os';
13 
14 /** Allowed family names (not product model IDs). */
15 export const SEAT_FAMILIES = Object.freeze(['chatgpt', 'claude', 'gemini', 'grok']);
16 
17 /**
18  * Subscription driver names only.
19  * gemini → gemini-cli (agy is an accepted alias for the same transport).
20  * grok → grok-cli (never raw "grok" HTTP + XAI_API_KEY).
21  */
22 export const SUBSCRIPTION_DRIVERS = Object.freeze([
23   'chatgpt-cli',
24   'claude',
25   'gemini-cli',
26   'agy',
27   'grok-cli',
28 ]);
29 
30 /** Drivers allowed on production seats (agy aliases gemini-cli). */
31 export const PRODUCTION_SEAT_DRIVERS = Object.freeze([
32   'chatgpt-cli',
33   'claude',
34   'gemini-cli',
35   'agy',
36   'grok-cli',
37 ]);
38 
39 /**
40  * Map coding/review family → subscription driver name.
41  * @param {string} family
42  * @returns {string|null}
43  */
44 export function familyToSubscriptionDriver(family) {
45   const f = String(family || '')
46     .trim()
47     .toLowerCase();
48   if (f === 'chatgpt' || f === 'codex') return 'chatgpt-cli';
49   if (f === 'claude') return 'claude';
50   if (f === 'gemini') return 'gemini-cli';
51   // Subscription Grok CLI only — never raw xAI HTTP driver name "grok"
52   if (f === 'grok') return 'grok-cli';
53   return null;
54 }
55 
56 /**
57  * Normalize family string; unknown → null.
58  * @param {*} value
59  * @returns {string|null}
60  */
61 export function normalizeFamily(value) {
62   const f = String(value || '')
63     .trim()
64     .toLowerCase();
65   if (SEAT_FAMILIES.includes(f)) return f;
66   return null;
67 }
68 
69 /**
70  * Resolve prefs file candidates without embedding host-absolute literals.
71  * Uses env ANCHOR_PREFS_PATH / ANCHOR_DATA_DIR / ANCHOR_SETTINGS_PATH,
72  * then home/.anchor/model_prefs.json and settings.json.
73  * @param {NodeJS.ProcessEnv} [env]
74  * @returns {string[]}
75  */
76 export function resolvePrefsCandidatePaths(env = process.env) {
77   const out = [];
78   const e = env || {};
79   if (e.ANCHOR_PREFS_PATH) out.push(String(e.ANCHOR_PREFS_PATH));
80   if (e.ANCHOR_SETTINGS_PATH) out.push(String(e.ANCHOR_SETTINGS_PATH));
81   if (e.ANCHOR_DATA_DIR) {
82     out.push(path.join(String(e.ANCHOR_DATA_DIR), 'model_prefs.json'));
83     out.push(path.join(String(e.ANCHOR_DATA_DIR), 'settings.json'));
84   }
85   // If the caller explicitly supplied HOME/USERPROFILE (even empty), honor that
86   // isolation and do NOT fall back to the real os.homedir — host-less / scrubbed
87   // envs pass empty strings so seats resolve as `defaults`, not machine disk.
88   const homeExplicit = Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(e, 'USERPROFILE')
89     || Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(e, 'HOME');
90   const home = e.USERPROFILE || e.HOME || (homeExplicit ? '' : (os.homedir?.() || ''));
91   if (home) {
92     out.push(path.join(home, '.anchor', 'model_prefs.json'));
93     out.push(path.join(home, '.anchor', 'settings.json'));
94   }
95   return out;
96 }
97 
98 /**
99  * Read first existing prefs/settings JSON that carries family fields.
100  * @param {{ env?: object, prefsPath?: string|null, readFile?: (p: string) => string, exists?: (p: string) => boolean }} [opts]
101  * @returns {{ coding_family?: string, review_family?: string, default_cli?: string, source?: string }|null}
102  */
103 export function loadAnchorPrefsFromDisk(opts = {}) {
104   const env = opts.env ?? process.env;
105   const exists = opts.exists ?? ((p) => fs.existsSync(p));
106   const readFile = opts.readFile ?? ((p) => fs.readFileSync(p, 'utf8'));
107 
108   const candidates = [];
109   if (opts.prefsPath) candidates.push(opts.prefsPath);
110   candidates.push(...resolvePrefsCandidatePaths(env));
111 
112   for (const filePath of candidates) {
113     if (!filePath || !exists(filePath)) continue;
114     try {
115       const raw = JSON.parse(readFile(filePath));
116       if (!raw || typeof raw !== 'object') continue;
117       const coding =
118         raw.coding_family ?? raw.codingFamily ?? raw.coding ?? null;
119       const review =
120         raw.review_family ?? raw.reviewFamily ?? raw.review ?? null;
121       const default_cli =
122         raw.default_cli ?? raw.defaultCli ?? raw.default_cli_name ?? null;
123       if (coding || review || default_cli) {
124         return {
125           coding_family: coding != null ? String(coding) : undefined,
126           review_family: review != null ? String(review) : undefined,
127           default_cli: default_cli != null ? String(default_cli) : undefined,
128           source: filePath,
129         };
130       }
131     } catch {
132       // best-effort — never block seat resolution on prefs IO
133     }
134   }
135   return null;
136 }
137 
138 /**
139  * Load Anchor model prefs (injectable for unit tests).
140  * Resolve order: opts.prefs → disk prefs → historical defaults.
141  * Family/default CLI environment values are deliberately ignored: Anchor
142  * settings / mirror are the sole durable preference source.
143  * @param {{ prefs?: object|null, env?: object, prefsPath?: string|null, readFile?: Function, exists?: Function }} [opts]
144  * @returns {{ coding_family: string, review_family: string, default_cli: string|null, source: string, cross_model: boolean }}
145  */
146 export function loadAnchorPrefs(opts = {}) {
147   const env = opts.env ?? process.env;
148   let coding = null;
149   let review = null;
150   let default_cli = null;
151   // Honest source name when prefs/env/disk absent (Wave 22 T-HOST-0 / NS criterion 14).
152   let source = 'defaults';
153 
154   if (opts.prefs && typeof opts.prefs === 'object') {
155     coding = normalizeFamily(
156       opts.prefs.coding_family ?? opts.prefs.codingFamily ?? opts.prefs.coding,
157     );
158     review = normalizeFamily(
159       opts.prefs.review_family ?? opts.prefs.reviewFamily ?? opts.prefs.review,
160     );
161     const dc =
162       opts.prefs.default_cli ?? opts.prefs.defaultCli ?? opts.prefs.default_cli;
163     default_cli = dc != null && dc !== '' ? String(dc) : null;
164     source = 'inject';
165   }
166 
167   if (!coding || !review || default_cli == null) {
168     const disk = loadAnchorPrefsFromDisk(opts);
169     if (disk) {
170       if (!coding && disk.coding_family) {
171         coding = normalizeFamily(disk.coding_family);
172       }
173       if (!review && disk.review_family) {
174         review = normalizeFamily(disk.review_family);
175       }
176       if (default_cli == null && disk.default_cli != null) {
177         default_cli = String(disk.default_cli);
178       }
179       if (source === 'defaults' || source === 'default') {
180         source = disk.source ? 'disk' : source;
181       }
182     }
183   }
184 
185   // Historical fallback DEFAULT when prefs absent (not a hard law)
186   if (!coding) coding = 'claude';
187   if (!review) review = 'gemini';
188 
189   const cross_model = coding !== review;
190   return {
191     coding_family: coding,
192     review_family: review,
193     default_cli,
194     source,
195     cross_model,
196   };
197 }

199 /**
200  * Patterns that look like vendor product model IDs (forbidden on seats).
201  * Families (chatgpt/claude/gemini/grok) and their subscription drivers are NOT matches.
202  */
203 export const PRODUCT_MODEL_ID_PATTERNS = Object.freeze([
204   // `fable` added 2026-08-04: the conversational seat's real reply carries
205   // `modelUsage: {"claude-fable-5": …}`, and the list predated that family — so the
206   // guard had a hole for the exact model in production use. Families ("claude") and
207   // drivers ("claude") still do NOT match: a bare name has no `-<product>` suffix.
208   /claude-(?:opus|sonnet|haiku|fable)[\w.-]*/i,
209   /claude-3(?:\.\d)?[\w.-]*/i,
210   /gemini-[\d.]+[\w.-]*/i,
211   /models\/gemini/i,
212   /grok-[234][\w.-]*/i,
213   /grok-beta/i,
214   /gpt-\d[\w.-]*/i,
215 ]);
216 
217 /**
218  * @param {*} value
219  * @returns {string[]}
220  */
221 export function findProductModelIds(value) {
222   const hits = [];
223   const walk = (v, trail) => {
224     if (v == null) return;
225     if (typeof v === 'string') {
226       for (const re of PRODUCT_MODEL_ID_PATTERNS) {
227         if (re.test(v)) {
228           hits.push(trail ? `${trail}=${v}` : v);
229           return;
230         }
231       }
232       return;
233     }
234     if (Array.isArray(v)) {
235       v.forEach((item, i) => walk(item, `${trail}[${i}]`));
236       return;
237     }
238     if (typeof v === 'object') {
239       for (const [k, child] of Object.entries(v)) {
240         walk(child, trail ? `${trail}.${k}` : k);
241       }
242     }
243   };
244   walk(value, '');
245   return hits;
246 }
247 
248 /**
249  * Resolve production seats from Anchor prefs.
250  * @param {{ prefs?: object|null, env?: object, prefsPath?: string|null }} [opts]
251  * @returns {object} seat stamp — subscription drivers only, honest cross_model
252  */
253 export function resolveSeats(opts = {}) {
254   const prefs = loadAnchorPrefs(opts);
255   const coding_driver = familyToSubscriptionDriver(prefs.coding_family);
256   const review_driver = familyToSubscriptionDriver(prefs.review_family);
257 
258   const seat = {
259     coding_family: prefs.coding_family,
260     review_family: prefs.review_family,
261     default_cli: prefs.default_cli,
262     coding_driver,
263     review_driver,
264     /** Honest stamp: false when same-family; true when families differ. */
265     cross_model: prefs.coding_family !== prefs.review_family,
266     prefs_source: prefs.source,
267     subscription_only: true,
268     /** Production seats never use raw xAI HTTP + API key. */
269     xai_http_seat: false,
270     xai_api_key_path: false,
271     product_model_ids: [],
272     drivers: {
273       coding: coding_driver,
274       review: review_driver,
275     },
276   };
277 
278   // Fail closed if a driver is missing or not a subscription CLI
279   const drivers = [coding_driver, review_driver];
280   for (const d of drivers) {
281     if (!d || !PRODUCTION_SEAT_DRIVERS.includes(d)) {
282       seat.ok = false;
283       seat.error = 'non_subscription_driver';
284       seat.message = `Seat driver must be subscription CLI only; got ${d}`;
285       return seat;
286     }
287   }
288 
289   // Raw HTTP grok driver name is forbidden for production seats
290   if (coding_driver === 'grok' || review_driver === 'grok') {
291     seat.ok = false;
292     seat.error = 'xai_http_seat_forbidden';
293     seat.message =
294       'Production seats must use grok-cli subscription transport, not raw grok HTTP';
295     return seat;
296   }
297 
298   const productHits = findProductModelIds(seat);
299   if (productHits.length) {
300     seat.ok = false;
301     seat.error = 'product_model_id_forbidden';
302     seat.message = `Seat stamp must not carry product model IDs: ${productHits.join(', ')}`;
303     seat.product_model_ids = productHits;
304     return seat;
305   }
306 
307   seat.ok = true;
308   return seat;
309 }
310 
311 /**
312  * True when a seat object is safe for production (subscription only, no product IDs, no XAI HTTP).
313  * @param {object} seat
314  */
315 export function isProductionSeatSafe(seat) {
316   if (!seat || typeof seat !== 'object') return false;
317   if (seat.xai_http_seat === true || seat.xai_api_key_path === true) return false;
318   if (seat.coding_driver === 'grok' || seat.review_driver === 'grok') return false;
319   if (findProductModelIds(seat).length) return false;
320   const drivers = [seat.coding_driver, seat.review_driver].filter(Boolean);
321   return drivers.every((d) => PRODUCTION_SEAT_DRIVERS.includes(d));
322 }
